question:
According to the Census 2011, arrange the following states/union territories on the basis of literacy rates, in ascending order.

A) Mizoram

B) Lakshadweep

C) Kerala
solution:
The correct answer is **__(A), (B), (C)__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mizoram:**

 
 
• Mizoram is ranked **3rd** in the overall literacy rate among the states and union territories in India.
 
• The literacy rate in Mizoram has seen an upward trend and is **91.33%** as per the 2011 population census.
 
• Of that,** male** literacy stands at** 93.35%,** while **female** literacy is at **89.27%**.
 
 
 
• **Lakshadweep:**
 
 
• According to Census 2011, Lakshadweep, with a literacy rate of** 91.8%**, is the **Union Territory with the highest literacy rate** in India.
 
• And according to the 2011 Census, Lakshadweep has the** second-highest literacy rate in India**.
 
 
 
• **Kerala:**
 
 
• The literacy rate in Kerala has seen an upward trend and is** 94.00 percent **as per the 2011 population census.
 
• Male literacy stands at **96.11 percent,** while female literacy is at **92.07 percent**.
 
• The total literacy rate of **Kerala **is **94%**, which is greater than the **average literacy rate** of **72.98% in India**.
